name: VIRICIDAL
source:
A pandemic is breaking out.

In an isolated Antarctica, you're part of the research team tasked with finding a cure. Survive the cold, seek answers, and go home before the end of the month.

That was the objective, until your team found a missing scientist. With no memory, his miraculous survival and appearance quickly raised questions.

Is he a liability, an answer, or something else entirely? 

Better decide fast. Your heart is bleeding, and so is the snow. 

[From [url=https://linglyum.itch.io/viricidal]itch.io[/url]]
